## CRM Data Hygiene Sentinel

1. Select credentials on every node that shows a warning.
2. Ships in DRY-RUN (SENTINEL_DRY_RUN=true). Set to false to write to the CRM.
3. Requires N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false to read settings from env, otherwise defaults are used.
4. Logic in 'Sanitize & Score' mirrors src/data-sanitizer.js.

See README.md for setup.
